name: Hero
description: Full-bleed hero banner for the top of a page. Fixed-height (600px), vertically centered, dark olive fallback background. Renders one static slide or a rotating Splide.js slider; each slide has its own background (theme color, image, or self-hosted/external video), eyebrow + headline + supporting text, and CTA buttons.
when_to_use: First block on landing and campaign pages. Use left/center/right for a static hero; the slider variant for rotating campaign banners with more than one slide. Do not use mid-page — use Section or Cta instead.
capabilities: content alignment via variant: left, center, right, or slider
slider variant adds side navigation arrows; slideshow dots appear automatically when there is more than one slide
background per slide: theme color | image | video (upload or external URL)
readability gradient by default over image/video, or an explicit dark/light overlay
0..n CTA buttons per slide (shared Factory Button spec)

variants.description: Left-aligned content with side navigation arrows for a multi-slide banner.

breakpoints.mobile: Content stacks, buttons wrap; banner height reduces to ~460px.

ai.prompt_summary: Hero: full-bleed page opener, fixed 600px height. Element settings: variant (left|center|right|slider), autoplay + loop (slider only). Content lives in slides[] (min 1); each slide: eyebrow, title, subline, text_color (auto|light|dark), background_type (color|image|video) + matching source field, overlay (none|dark|light), buttons[] (label, to, color, variant [solid|outline|ghost|outline-white|white-solid], button_size, icon). Slideshow dots show automatically for multiple slides.
ai.content_guidelines: Headline at most 8 words. Eyebrow uppercase, may use ' · ' separators for a location/tagline line. 0-2 buttons per slide; on the dark hero use outline-white then white-solid button variants.

field_hints.slides.background_color: Semantic theme token (primary, secondary, ...), never a hex value.
field_hints.slides.text_color: Leave at 'auto' unless contrast fails on the chosen background.
field_hints.slides.background_video_url: Only as alternative to an uploaded file; direct mp4/webm URL.
